result.stdout:
s1kd-tools — tools for S1000D data (C# port)

Usage: s1kd <tool> [options] [files]

Available tools:
  acronyms       Manage acronyms in S1000D data modules.
  addicn         Add entity/notation declarations for an ICN.
  appcheck       Validate the applicability of S1000D CSDB objects.
  aspp           Applicability statement preprocessor.
  brexcheck      Check CSDB objects against BREX data modules.
  defaults       .defaults, .dmtypes and .fmtypes files management tool.
  dmrl           Create CSDB objects from a DMRL.
  flatten        Flatten a publication module for distribution.
  fmgen          Generate front matter content for a data module from a publication module.
  icncatalog     Manage the catalog used to resolve ICNs.
  index          Flag index keywords in a data module.
  instance       Produce filtered instances of S1000D CSDB objects.
  ls             List CSDB objects in a directory.
  metadata       View and edit S1000D metadata on CSDB objects.
  mvref          Change one reference into another in S1000D CSDB objects.
  neutralize     Generate IETP-neutral metadata for CSDB objects.
  newcom         Create a new S1000D comment.
  newddn         Create a new data dispatch note.
  newdm          Create a new S1000D data module.
  newdml         Create a new data management list (DML).
  newimf         Create a new ICN metadata file (IMF).
  newpm          Create a new S1000D publication module.
  newsmc         Create a new SCORM content package (SMC).
  newupf         Create a new data update file.
  pdfdiff        Compare two PDFs and report the differences (for stylesheet work).
  pdfdump        Dump a PDF's page structure and layout measurements.
  ref            Generate XML to reference CSDB objects.
  refs           List references in CSDB objects.
  render         Render CSDB objects to PDF, text, Markdown or HTML (via FOP.Sharp).
  repcheck       Validate CIR references in S1000D CSDB objects.
  sns            Organize a CSDB into a directory structure based on an SNS.
  syncrefs     
[truncated]
